static_audit.scope: Bounded read-only review of committed LH public/default dataflow versus the independent direct anchor. No new timing, profiling, build or device execution. Only this ignored audit artifact is written.

predecessor.reuse: Previously inspected files with unchanged hashes retain the same mechanisms; changed aggregate, placement, write and VJP paths were re-read. This is targeted symbol/dataflow review, not a whole-repository audit.

workload_context.topology: LH176, 22 regions x 8 nodes, 1058 internal edges; layer region counts 1/2/4/8/4/2/1
workload_context.timing_scope: Parent supplies the fixed-source direct/public/default measurements separately. CPU default and NPU public scopes are different; this audit does not turn their deltas into per-operation times.

notation.G: compatible nodes or unique receivers in a numerical group, at most 8 for one LH176 region; budgets/reuse/support can split or reduce it
notation.R: maximum actual flattened B x L receiver row count in a group; at most 64 in this window
notation.A: maximum number of physical source uses per receiver, including duplicate edges
notation.S: unique source/input plus full ordered parameter-role slots in a direct region
notation.Q,K: padded per-sample query and raw-bank lengths
notation.M: sum of actual row counts across receiver physical-source uses
notation.F: actual Read descriptor field count (4 for ind, 6 with att x/key fields in this workload)

findings.finding: C++ FP32/FP64 writes now use one grouped normalization/projection formula and no longer bucket by exact positive-write count. Aggregate mean and centered VJP now operate on grouped tensors. mixed-a Read transport now shares one mapper for each destination device/dtype, retaining actual shared parameter identity across nodes. These old gaps must not be reported as still open.
findings.input_output: Grouped positive writes produce raw key/value/summary/weight fields; grouped Aggregate produces total mass and content for each receiver.
findings.bounds: Multi-node FP32/FP64 eligible groups use the new paths. Singleton, half and workspace fallback remain explicitly different paths.

findings.input_output: Public: physical-use mass [rows] and transformed content [rows,D] -> index [G,R,A] -> mass [G,R,A], value [G,R,A,D] -> receiver mass [G,R], content [G,R,D]. Direct: unique transformed source block [S,B,L,D] and incidence [region_nodes,S] -> two incidence contractions -> mass/content region blocks.
findings.loops_and_work: Public metadata visits every receiver/source use and its actual rows (M entries); C++ lower_bound costs O(M log R), plus index initialization of G*R*A. Value and its centered VJP materialize O(G*R*A*D), including shared source payload repeated at different receivers. Each grad-enabled group has a positive.any host read. Forward publishes 2G receiver views; backward copies up to 2G receiver bars and applies clamp derivative separately for each physical-source use.
findings.finding: Mean arithmetic is batched now. The remaining gap is the receiver/source Cartesian payload layout, publication and root restoration. Source MLP reuse does not remove this second duplication of values. Physical duplicate edges must count independently, but mathematics does not require storing a D-vector copy at every use.
findings.direct_caveat: Direct incidence is constructed once for its static topology and ordered parameter roles. A replacement must preserve separate roots/use multiplicity and actual message presence rather than deduplicating SrcClass.

findings.input_output: Internal [G,B,Q/K,...] tensors -> per-node raw/descriptor dictionaries -> newly concatenated/gathered [G,B,Q/K,...] inputs at the next stage.
findings.loops_and_work: Per eligible group, writes publish 4G fields, Read F*G fields, Full one field per active node through index_select. G=8 gives 32 write and 32/48 Read publications before later repack. Every bank-changing node then runs four cat+index_select assemblies, plus four terminal trim selects when windowing is active. Read sum packs four data roles, qry five, selected active Full four; Read and Full repack raw banks independently. Backward assembles field bars and restores per-node roots even though private arithmetic is already grouped.
findings.finding: The no-grad/custom-VJP boundary prevents these layout operations from producing a proportional ordinary autograd graph, but it does not eliminate their tensor dispatch, copies, metadata work or explicit gradient restoration. Direct keeps region-shaped raw banks and decodes only when requested.
findings.metadata: Python builds int64 age/bool visible [G,B,Q,K] on CPU then transfers; C++ builds age/visible on payload device. Direct can broadcast common Q,K logical times for this aligned workload. General ragged/time semantics still require exact int64 metadata.

findings.input_output: Per-node descriptor fields [actual_rows,...] -> actual-cardinality group [row_count,candidates,...] -> per-node control columns -> selected Full queries.
findings.loops_and_work: CPU incidence planning visits every candidate node-row occurrence. Number of numerical candidate-cardinality groups is at most the region node count, not necessarily B*L. Each descriptor is stacked, or concatenated/gathered for ragged rows; aligned controls unbind, ragged controls use inverse gather. Training adds support/branch host decisions and field/participant cotangent transforms. Full eligibility validates per-node controls and extracts active indices/host rows.
findings.finding: The solver need not be replaced to remove descriptor/control re-publication. Carry grouped descriptors, actual candidate support and grouped controls across the region boundary, with a declared selected-Full plan. Do not replace selected-only Full by all-node Full times zero merely because the direct anchor uses a narrower dense numerical projection.

findings.input_output: Source columns -> grouped source MLP -> per-source transformed values; then one region-stage pipeline.
findings.loops_and_work: Source transform exact reuse already requires identical actual input and complete ordered parameter roles. Shared A/B are still stacked before shared-GEMM detection. Both public and direct iterate the 22 LH176 regions, including same-rank regions; public iterates node ownership at stage boundaries but its eligible numerical chain is not token-by-token PDG decode.
findings.finding: Avoid claiming every physical edge repeats the MLP, or that merely replacing the outer region loop explains the gap. Existing exact reuse/grouped GEMM is real. Early shared-role detection is a smaller follow-up; persistent region/source blocks are the more valuable boundary.

findings.input_output: Completed column state -> B x node State records -> per-node raw bank import at a later window; Python native adapter reconstructs node/edge int64 metadata.
findings.loops_and_work: Export iterates up to B*N state ownership (704 at B4/N176); import concatenates each node bank again. Actual raw slot work depends on retained K. This is outside public column execution.
findings.finding: A typed continuation handle can defer exact codec/projection until serialization or requested observations. The default codec is a plausible default/public delta, but cannot explain a public/direct timing gap.

Same device/dtype returns the original tensor; mixed presets do not inherently require floating-point transfers. mixed-a shared Read transport was fixed. mixed-b still copies low/high selection aliases independently. The current mixed-c LH gap must not be attributed to this mixed-a or mixed-b mechanism; host support/finite/branch work remains relevant.

priority_successor.boundary: Persistent region-window numerical context with source-owner blocks and typed raw-bank blocks.
priority_successor.design: Compile topology/source incidence once; compose actual presence into row/owner maps. Aggregate consumes unique source blocks without receiver-by-source payload replication. Keep writes, Read descriptors, regional solver groups, selected controls and Full in typed grouped handles; reuse raw bank/layout rather than publishing node dictionaries between numerical stages. Stage-specific shapes remain schema-defined; KV and fixed-state recurrent modules need not share one universal tensor. Only actual cross-device movement, requested independent observations and exact checkpoint serialization impose projection/transport boundaries.
priority_successor.vjp: One explicit transpose per real boundary, with structural dependence support separate from numeric zero; retain repeated-edge contributions, equal-but-independent roots, shared-role identity, mutation versions, None/zero and raw checkpoint state. Parameter/compute sharing is legal only under actual identical inputs and complete ordered roles.
priority_successor.static_acceptance: For an eligible aligned region, no per-node field publication followed immediately by cat/gather between writes, Read, region allocation and Full; no G*R*A*D copied payload when source-owner incidence suffices; retain actual selected-only Full and logical-time semantics. Public per-node/port observations remain explicit supported projections.
priority_successor.finite_validation: Reuse independent formula/root/raw-state/restoration witnesses, then the parent existing FC16/LH176 direct/public/default finite protocol. Report stage publications, actual tensor movement, outer/private graph and actual selected work separately. Do not require a new all-combinations matrix.
priority_successor.why_next: This removes a repeated representation transition across several local modules. Another isolated arithmetic batching change would leave the same repeated layout/publication boundary intact.

limits: Source-level ATen expressions, Python loops and C++ loops are not measured device kernel counts or attributed wall times.
Padding/group/reuse/budget/active-domain conditions change actual counts; formulas above are conditional structural bounds, not observed invocation totals.
The direct anchor has a narrower projection, dense Full behavior and its own quadratic solver; it is not a complete general graph executor or a universal optimal-performance bound.
Required physical edge multiplicity, support/existence, exact logical time and checkpoint decode do not force per-node intermediate numerical storage.
No correctness limit, device qualification or performance claim is closed by this static review alone.
